notes.general_comments:
This examination paper provided a difficult challenge to the candidates with some pleasing performances.
Ten questions can be said to have been found to be easier. 50% or more of candidates chose the correct
responses to each of Questions 8, 9, 11, 13, 20, 22, 28, 29, 33 and 35. Questions 38 and 39 were also
answered correctly by a high proportion of candidates, suggesting they had sufficient time.
Seven questions can be said to have been found to be particularly difficult. Fewer than 25% of candidates
chose the correct responses to each of Questions 4, 6, 10, 24, 25, 37 and 40.
